  <p class="visually-hidden" id="rf-desc">Three research directions form one sequence. A shows data center water-energy coupling and a sequence of evolving material structures. B shows a neural operator mapping an input field to a predicted state. C shows an illustrative state trajectory under a constraint and an input schedule. The solid arrows connect learning, optimization, and physical action. A dashed arrow returns decision error to model training.</p>
